commit.message: fix: fix utstack example's compiling error

Stop using `gets` in example.c.

Thanks to @pdebuyl for the outline of this patch!
Use `malloc(sizeof *s)` in example code.
Fix a "bug" in the example where option 3 interfered with option 1's counter.
Update http:// URLs to https://, and copyright dates to 2022. NFC.

Update test57.c per a suggestion by @mark-summerfield

Use a non-null `someaddr`, and use more thorough asserts instead
of a single printf so that we get a bit more test coverage here.

CI: Add GitHub Actions CI

Add a basic GitHub Actions CI action that copies ".travis.yml".

Fixes #243.

The MCST Elbrus C Compiler supports __typeof. (#247)

The trick here is that MCST's compiler is also colloquially
known as "LCC", so it defines `__LCC__`; so we'd think it was
the [Retargetable C Compiler](https://drh.github.io/lcc/) and
assume it had no `__typeof`. Check for `__MCST__` before checking
for `__LCC__`.

Thanks to @utf-4096 for the patch!

GitHub CI: Also test building the docs (#248)

Thanks to @aloisklink for the patch!

utarray_str_cpy: Remove strdup; utarray_oom() if strdup fails.

Fixes #250, #216, #184.

utarray: Stop making `oom` a synonym for `utarray_oom`

We changed `-Doom=...` to `-Dutarray_oom=...` in commit cfc95dbe,
part of the uthash 2.1.0 release (Dec 2018). Since then, we've had
uthash 2.2.0 (Dec 2020) and 2.3.0 (Feb 2021). I think that's enough
time for people to update their projects. Remove the backward-compatibility
hack `#define utarray_oom oom`.

utlist: Add one more assertion in DL_DELETE2

Fixes #252.

HASH_DEL should be able to delete a const-qualified node

HASH_DEL doesn't need to modify the target node; in fact it should not,
because that target node is usually going straight back to `free` and
any modifications to it would be wasted effort. So, let's make that an
actual tested guarantee, and let's make it const-correct.

Inspired by the discussion in #253.
uthash: Improve the docs for HASH_ADD_INORDER

Fix MSVC warning C4127 in HASH_BLOOM_TEST (#261)

MSVC `-W4` gives "warning C4127: conditional expression is constant"
for `if (1 != 0)`, but no warning for `if (1)`. Use the latter instead
of the former. In fact, the comparison against zero should really be
all the way down in `HASH_BLOOM_BITTEST`.

No functional change intended.

Thanks to @noodlecollie for the patch!
utarray: Fix typo in docs

uthash: Eliminate HASH_DEFINE_OWN_STDINT

This macro was introduced in 15ad0427 for the benefit of people
who were relying on "uthash.h" to define its own `uint8_t` and
`uint32_t` typedefs, instead of either (1) getting them from the
Standard Library or (2) getting them from the user-programmer
somehow (e.g. `typedef char uint8_t` before including "uthash.h").
I see two projects using `HASH_NO_STDINT`, but zero projects
using `HASH_DEFINE_OWN_STDINT`, and somehow five years have passed;
it's time to kill off `HASH_DEFINE_OWN_STDINT`.
Update copyright years to 2025

utstring.h: utstring_find should be able to find within a const UT_string

Fixes #267.
Remove DOS-style newlines from four tests

[utarray] Add utarray_replace macro to safely replace elements (#272)

Introduces a new macro function utarray_replace in utarray.h,
which enables safe replacement of an element in a UT_array.

Currently, modifying an element in a UT_array often involves retrieving
a pointer via utarray_eltptr and then directly assigning a new value.
However, this method bypasses any user-defined ctor or dtor functions,
potentially leading to memory leaks or undefined behavior when managing
complex data types.

The new utarray_replace macro ensures that when an element is replaced:
- The existing element is properly destroyed using the dtor, if defined.
- The new element is constructed via the ctor, if defined.
Fix typo in doubly-linked list documentation

tests: Suppress -Wstrict-prototypes on mainline Clang

Apparently C these days thinks "int main()" is deprecated.
But "int main(void)" is both unidiomatic in C++, and silly in C.
So just suppress the warning. In a few years C will likely decide
that "int main()" means the same as "int main(void)" and then we
can un-disable the warning again.
hashscan: Silence a -Wunused-but-set-variable warning from Clang. NFC.
tests: Silence some -Wtype-limits warnings from GCC. NFC.

test88: Silence an overzealous deprecation warning about sprintf

AppleClang('s headers) currently warns about any use of `sprintf`.
This is certainly silly, but okay, it's easy enough to avoid.
utlist: Improve test coverage of {LL,DL,CDL}_{PREPEND,APPEND}{,_ELEM}. NFC.

utlist: Add LL_REVERSE/DL_REVERSE/CDL_REVERSE (#278)

Thanks to xunicatt for the patch!

utlist: Exhaustive white-box testing of {LL,DL}_CONCAT. NFC.

Commit 6346342267 changed test86.c to be more "white-box" about
what actually happens to the prev and next fields during an
{LL,DL,CDL}_APPEND. This commit does the same to test63.c and
test64.c, for {LL,DL}_CONCAT, and merges them into one test file.

utlist: Add CDL_CONCAT (#280)

Thanks to xunicatt for the patch!
Bump version to v2.4.0.

+name: build # This name shows up in badge.svg
+
+on:
+  push: # any branch
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [ "master" ]
+
+jobs:
+  build-gcc:
+    strategy:
+      matrix:
+        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
+    steps:
+    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
+    - run: make -C tests EXTRA_CFLAGS="-W -Wall -Wextra -Wswitch-default"
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests pedantic
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests pedantic EXTRA_CFLAGS=-DNO_DECLTYPE
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests cplusplus
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests cplusplus EXTRA_CFLAGS=-DNO_DECLTYPE
+  build-clang:
+    strategy:
+      matrix:
+        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
+    env:
+      CC: clang
+      CXX: clang++
+    steps:
+    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
+    - run: make -C tests EXTRA_CFLAGS="-W -Wall -Wextra -Wswitch-default"
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests pedantic
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests pedantic EXTRA_CFLAGS=-DNO_DECLTYPE
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests cplusplus
+    - run: make -C tests clean ; make -C tests cplusplus EXTRA_CFLAGS=-DNO_DECLTYPE
+  build-asciidoc:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
+    - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install asciidoc -y
+    - run: make -C doc
